payload.title: Calls — SFU media placement in Rust (Local + Cluster home-node registry)
payload.description: PARITY GAP from the calls cutover (board audit). The TS sfu-media-plane.ts injected a MediaPlacement seam (placeFor(callId) -> MediaHome); the Rust SfuMediaPlaneAdapter::new() takes only a backend Arc, has NO placement field, and allocate_session hardcodes region from the hint or 'local' — so multi-region/multi-box SFU is impossible. The cluster bus envelopes (MediaPlacementClaim/Release) already exist in crates/frick-server/src/cluster (envelope), but the gateway IGNORES them (~line 2151). Port cluster-media-placement.ts (239 lines, deleted in 763e5d2): a MediaPlacement trait, LocalMediaPlacement (single-box default, always local), and ClusterMediaPlacement (bus-coordinated home-node registry via the existing MediaPlacementClaim/Release envelopes, lowest-nodeId tie-break, TTL self-heal). Inject into SfuMediaPlaneAdapter::new(placement). This is the Rust re-implementation of FR-154 (multi-box SFU placement, which is 'done' in the TS era only). Depends on the SFU media-negotiation ticket.
